currency_note: Task requested native currency. CLCT's audited consolidated financial statements (statement of total return, balance sheet, cash flows, distribution statement) are PRESENTED in Singapore dollars (S$'000) - see statement headers p90-99 ("2024 $'000"). Native/as-reported currency for financial.json and performance.json is therefore SGD, not RMB. RMB figures exist only as a secondary dual-currency column in the Portfolio Statement (valuation) and Financial Review (GR/NPI) property tables; these are preserved as audit fields on properties (_rmb_valuation_000, _gross_revenue_rmb_000, _npi_rmb_000). No FX conversion was performed by the extractor.
